title.zh: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二 徽宗四
title.raw: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二 徽宗四 Volume 22 Annals 22: Huizong 4

sentences.zh: 宣和元年春正月戊申朔，日下有五色雲。

translations.literal: Xuanhe year 1, spring, first month, day wushen new moon: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 1, spring, wushen new moon: five-colored clouds hung under the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬子，進建安郡王樞為肅王，文安郡王杞為景王，並為太保。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Prince of Jian'an commandery, Shu, was advanced to Prince of Su; the Prince of Wen'an commandery, Qi, to Prince of Jing; both were made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Princes Shu of Jian'an and Qi of Wen'an became Su and Jing, both Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔：「佛改號大覺金仙，余為仙人、大士。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict—"Buddha is renamed Great Awakened Golden Immortal; the rest are immortals and great lords.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Huizong decreed: Buddha became Great Awakened Golden Immortal; lesser figures became immortals and great lords.

sentences.zh: 僧為德士，易服飾，稱姓氏。

translations.literal: Monks are Virtuous Gentlemen; they change dress and use surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Monks became Virtuous Gentlemen, shed robes, and took surnames.

sentences.zh: 寺為宮，院為觀。

translations.literal: Temples are palaces; cloisters are vieweries."
translations.idiomatic: Temples became palaces; cloisters became vieweries.

sentences.zh: 」改女冠為女道，尼為女德。

translations.literal: Female Daoists were renamed female wayfarers; nuns, female virtues.
translations.idiomatic: Female Daoists became wayfarers; nuns became female virtues.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，金人使李善慶來，遣趙有開報聘，至登州而還。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the Jin envoy Li Shanqing came; Zhao Youkai was sent to return the embassy and turned back at Deng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Jin envoy Li Shanqing arrived; Zhao Youkai answered the embassy but turned back at Deng.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以余深為太宰兼門下侍郎，王黼為特進、少宰兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Yu Shen was made Grand Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; Wang Fu was made Special Advanced, Junior Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yu Shen took the Grand Chancellery and Wang Fu the Junior Secretariat, both as vice directors.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改湟州為樂州。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Huang prefecture was renamed Le prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Huang became Le prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封子棟為溫國公，侄有恭為永甯郡王。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: son Dong was enfeoffed Duke of Wenguo; nephew Yougong was enfeoffed Prince of Yongning commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Dong became Duke of Wenguo and nephew Yougong Prince of Yongning.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，躬耕籍田。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the emperor personally plowed the sacrificial fields.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Huizong plowed the sacrificial fields himself.

sentences.zh: 罷裕民局。

translations.literal: The Bureau for Enriching the People was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau for Enriching the People was struck.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，改元。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengchen: the reign title became Xuanhe.

sentences.zh: 易宣和殿為保和殿。

translations.literal: Xuanhe Hall was renamed Baohe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe Hall became Baohe Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以鄧洵武為少保。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Deng Xunwu was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Deng Xunwu became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，蔡京等進安州所得商六鼎。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: Cai Jing and others presented six Shang bronze vessels taken at An prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengxu: Cai Jing presented six Shang vessels from An prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，以馮熙載為中書侍郎，范致虛為尚書左丞，翰林學士張邦昌為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Feng Xizai was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Fan Zhixu was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Hanlin academician Zhang Bangchang was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Feng Xizai took the Secretariat, Fan Zhixu the left State Affairs chair, and Zhang Bangchang the right.

sentences.zh: 詔天下知宮觀道士與監司、郡縣官以客禮相見。

translations.literal: An edict: abbots of palaces and vieweries throughout the realm were to meet circuit supervisors and prefectural officials as guests.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong ordered abbots empire-wide to greet circuit and county officers as guests.

sentences.zh: 童貫遣知熙州劉法出師攻統安城，夏人伏兵擊之，法敗歿，震武軍受圍。

translations.literal: Tong Guan sent Liu Fa, prefect of Xi, to attack Tong'an fortress; the Western Xia ambushed him; Fa was defeated and killed, and Zhenwu Army was besieged.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan sent Xi prefect Liu Fa against Tong'an; Xia ambushed him; Fa fell and Zhenwu was besieged.

sentences.zh: 甲子，知登州宗澤坐建神霄宮不虔，除名編管。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Zong Ze, prefect of Deng, for irreverence in building the Divine Empyrean Palace, was struck from the rolls and exiled under guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Deng prefect Zong Ze was struck from the rolls for irreverence at the Divine Empyrean Palace and exiled.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜上舍生五十四人及第。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: fifty-four upper-academy students were granted the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, fifty-four upper-academy men took jinshi.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇后親蠶。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the empress personally tended silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the empress tended silkworms herself.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingzi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingzi new moon: the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，童貫以鄜延、環慶兵大破夏人，平其三城。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Tong Guan with Fengyan and Huanqing troops heavily defeated the Western Xia and leveled three cities.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Tong Guan smashed the Xia with Fengyan and Huanqing troops and razed three cities.

sentences.zh: 己亥，曲赦陝西、河東路。

translations.literal: Day jihai: partial amnesty in Shaanxi and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Shaanxi and Hedong won a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，進輔臣官一等。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: assistant ministers were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, every assistant minister rose one rank.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午朔，有物如龍形，見京師民家。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu new moon: something dragon-shaped was seen at a commoner's house in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingwu new moon: a dragon-shaped thing appeared in a capital house.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔德士並許入道學，依道士法。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict—Virtuous Gentlemen were all permitted to enter Daoist schools and follow Daoist law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, former monks could enter Daoist schools and live by Daoist law.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敗夏人于震武。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Western Xia were defeated at Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Xia were beaten at Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，班禦制《九星二十八宿朝元冠服圖》。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the emperor's Nine Stars and Twenty-Eight Mansions Court-Audience Cap and Robe Diagram was displayed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Huizong displayed his Nine Stars and Twenty-Eight Mansions court robes.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 是月，大水犯都城，西北有赤氣亙天。

translations.literal: That month, great floods assailed the capital; red vapor spanned the northwest sky.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods struck the capital and red mist filled the northwest sky.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，詔西邊武臣為經略使者改用文臣。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: an edict—western border military commissioners serving as circuit commissioners were to be replaced by civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renwu: western military commissioners were swapped for civil men.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔封莊周為微妙元通真君，列禦寇為致虛觀妙真君，仍行冊命，配享混元皇帝。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: an edict—Zhuang Zhou was enfeoffed True Lord of Subtle Wonder and Primal Penetration; Lie Yukou was enfeoffed True Lord of Reaching Emptiness and Viewing Wonder; investiture rites were performed; they shared sacrifice with the Primordial Unity Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhuang Zhou and Lie Yukou were canonized true lords, invested, and enshrined with the Primordial Unity Emperor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏國遣使納款，詔六路罷兵。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Western Xia sent envoys to submit; the six circuits were ordered to cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Xia sued for peace and six frontier circuits stood down.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，以童貫為太傅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiayin: Tong Guan was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiayin: Tong Guan became Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，詔諸路未方田處並令方量，均定租課。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: an edict—all circuits where equal-field measurement had not been applied were to be measured and rents fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuyin: every circuit still without equal-field survey was to be measured and taxed evenly.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以神霄宮成，降德音於天下。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: because the Divine Empyrean Palace was completed, a grace decree was issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the finished Divine Empyrean Palace won a grace decree for the realm.

sentences.zh: 范致虛以母憂去位。

translations.literal: Fan Zhixu left office on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhixu left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰朔，燕蔡京於保和新殿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen new moon: Cai Jing was banqueted at Baohe New Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiachen new moon: Huizong feasted Cai Jing at Baohe New Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the great offering was made at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Bright Hall received the great offering.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸道德院觀金芝，遂幸蔡京第。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the emperor visited the Moral Virtue Cloister to view golden fungus, then visited Cai Jing's mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Huizong saw golden fungus at the Moral Virtue Cloister, then called at Cai Jing's house.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以淮康軍節度使蔡攸為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Cai You, military commissioner of Huaikang Army, was made Kaifu with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Huaikang commissioner Cai You took Kaifu with Three Excellencies ceremony.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，以《紹述熙豐政事書》佈告天下。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu new moon: The Book of Continuing the Zhezong and Shenzong Administrations was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiaxu new moon: Huizong posted the Book of Continuing Zhezong and Shenzong policy empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guichou: Huizong offered at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Imperial Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Imperial Temple was feasted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Lord on High was sacrificed to at the Round Mound; amnesty for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Huizong sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound and pardoned the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔東南諸路水災，令監司、郡守悉心振救。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict—southeast circuits suffering flood; circuit supervisors and prefects were to relieve with all care.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, flooded southeast circuits were told to save lives with all care.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以淮甸旱，饑民失業，遣監察御史察訪。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: because the Huai region suffered drought and famine refugees lost their livelihoods, investigating censors were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, drought on the Huai drove refugees from work; censors were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 張邦昌為尚書左丞，翰林學士王安中為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Zhang Bangchang was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Hanlin academician Wang Anzhong was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangchang took the left State Affairs chair and Wang Anzhong the right.

sentences.zh: 時朱勔以花石綱媚上，東南騷動，太學生鄧肅進詩諷諫，詔放歸田裏。

translations.literal: At the time Zhu Mian, with the Flower-and-Stone convoys, pleased the throne; the southeast was in turmoil; Imperial University student Deng Su submitted satirical verse; he was sent home to his village by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Mian's Flower-and-Stone convoys pleased Huizong and roiled the southeast; student Deng Su's satirical poem sent him home.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔京東東路盜賊竊發，令東、西路提刑督捕之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: an edict—bandits had risen in eastern Jingdong circuit; eastern and western circuit investigating commissioners were to hunt them down.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiaxu: eastern Jingdong bandits were to be hunted by both investigating commissioners.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, hail hammered the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，帝數微行，正字曹輔上書極論之，編管郴州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the emperor often went out incognito; Rectifier Cao Fu memorialized vehemently; he was exiled under guard to Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Huizong slipped out in disguise again; Rectifier Cao Fu protested fiercely and was exiled to Chen.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京西饑，淮東大旱，遣官振濟。

translations.literal: That year, Jingxi suffered famine and Huaidong great drought; officials were sent to relieve.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jingxi starved, Huaidong withered, and relief officers went out.

sentences.zh: 嵐州黃河清。

translations.literal: At Lan prefecture the Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: At Lan prefecture the Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 升邢州為信德，陳州為淮寧，襄州為襄陽，慶州為慶陽，安州為德安，鄆州為東平，趙州為慶源府；

translations.literal: Xing was elevated to Xinde, Chen to Huaining, Xiang to Xiangyang, Qing to Qingyang, An to De'an, Yun to Dongping, and Zhao to Qingyuan Superior Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Xing became Xinde, Chen Huaining, Xiang Xiangyang, Qing Qingyang, An De'an, Yun Dongping, and Zhao Qingyuan Superior Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 瀘州為瀘川，睦州為建德，岳州為岳陽，寧州為興寧，宜州為慶遠，光州為光山，均州為武當軍。

translations.literal: Lu to Luchuan, Mu to Jiande, Yue to Yueyang, Ning to Xingning, Yi to Qingyuan, Guang to Guangshan, and Jun to Wudang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Luchuan, Mu Jiande, Yue Yueyang, Ning Xingning, Yi Qingyuan, Guang Guangshan, and Jun Wudang Army.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸亥，追封蔡確為汝南郡王。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day guihai: Cai Que was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Runan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 2, spring, guihai: Cai Que was made posthumous Prince of Runan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷道學。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Daoist schools were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Daoist schools were struck.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，遣趙良嗣使金國。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai: Zhao Liangsi was sent as envoy to the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: Zhao Liangsi went to Jin.

sentences.zh: 唐恪罷。

translations.literal: Tang Ke was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ke left office.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以甯遠軍節度使梁子美為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Liang Zimei, military commissioner of Ningyuan Army, was made Kaifu with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Ningyuan commissioner Liang Zimei took Kaifu with Three Excellencies ceremony.

sentences.zh: 戊子，令所在贍給淮南流民，諭還之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: wherever they were, Huainan refugees were to be fed and told to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Huainan refugees were to be fed wherever found and sent home.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔別修《哲宗史》。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict—a separate History of Emperor Zhezong was to be compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, a separate History of Zhezong was ordered.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，賜上舍生二十一人及第。

translations.literal: Third month, day renyin: twenty-one upper-academy students were granted the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renyin: twenty-one upper-academy men took jinshi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，改熙河蘭湟路為熙河蘭廓路。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Xihe Lantun circuit was renamed Xihe Lanluo circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Xihe Lantun became Xihe Lanluo circuit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，詔江西、廣東兩界群盜嘯聚，添置武臣提刑，路分都監各一員。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingzi: an edict—bandit gangs had gathered on the Jiangxi-Guangdong border; one military investigating commissioner and one route patrol commander each were added.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingzi: Jiangxi-Guangdong bandits won a military investigating commissioner and a route patrol commander apiece.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子朔，以淑妃劉氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengzi new moon: Pure Consort Liu was made Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengzi new moon: Pure Consort Liu became Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 己酉，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a sunspot showed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祭地于方澤，降德音于諸路。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Earth was sacrificed at the Square Mound; a grace decree was issued in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Huizong sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound and sent grace to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 布衣朱夢說上書論宦寺權太重，編管池州。

translations.literal: Commoner Zhu Mengshuo memorialized that eunuch power was too great; he was exiled under guard to Chi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Commoner Zhu Mengshuo warned that eunuchs held too much power and was exiled to Chi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔宗室有文行才術者，令大宗正司以聞。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict—imperial clansmen with learning, conduct, or talent were to be reported by the Chief Imperial Clan Office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, talented clansmen were to be reported to the Chief Imperial Clan Office.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，詔開封府振濟饑民。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: an edict—Kaifeng prefecture was to relieve famine refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guiyou: Kaifeng was told to feed famine refugees.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Venus was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蔡京致仕，仍朝朔望。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Cai Jing retired but still attended on the first and fifteenth of the month.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Cai Jing retired yet still came to court on the first and fifteenth.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔自今動改元豐法制，論以大不恭。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: an edict—from now on anyone who moved to alter Yuanfeng institutions was to be charged with great irreverence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, tampering with Yuanfeng law was branded great irreverence.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔三省、樞密院額外吏職，並從裁汰。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: an edict—extra clerical posts in the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs were all to be cut as judged fit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, extra clerks in the Three Departments and Military Affairs were cut at will.

sentences.zh: 及有妄言惑眾、稽違詔令者，重論之。

translations.literal: Those who uttered wild words to confuse the masses or dragged out edicts were to be heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: Wild talk that stirred the crowd or stalled edicts would be punished hard.

sentences.zh: 詔諸司總轄、提點之類，非元豐法並罷。

translations.literal: An edict—all general superintendents, intendant inspectors, and the like not under Yuanfeng law were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Every general superintendent and intendant outside Yuanfeng law was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復寺院額。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: monastery placards were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, monastery placards returned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷禮制局並修書五十八所。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Bureau of Ritual Regulation and fifty-eight book-compilation offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Ritual Regulation Bureau and fifty-eight book offices were struck.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，罷文臣起復。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: civil officials' hurried return from mourning was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renzi: civil hurry-back from mourning ended.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷醫、算學。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: medical and mathematical schools were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, medical and math schools closed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，封子楒為英國公。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: son Si was enfeoffed Duke of Yingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Si became Duke of Yingguo.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，詔減定醫官額。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen: an edict—medical officer quotas were reduced and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengchen: medical officer quotas were cut and fixed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔監司所舉守令非其人，或廢法不舉，令廉訪使者劾之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict—if circuit supervisors recommended unfit magistrates or neglected the law, integrity-visiting commissioners were to impeach.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, bad magistrate picks or neglected law by circuit men would draw impeachment by integrity visitors.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，金人遣勃堇等來。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: the Jin sent Boqin and others.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin: Jin envoys led by Boqin arrived.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復德士為僧。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Virtuous Gentlemen were restored as monks.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Virtuous Gentlemen became monks again.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the great offering was made at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Bright Hall received the great offering.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣馬政使金國。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Ma Zheng was sent as envoy to the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Ma Zheng went to Jin.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，余深加少傅。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Yu Shen was advanced to Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Yu Shen became Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 宴童貫第。

translations.literal: A banquet was held at Tong Guan's mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong banqueted at Tong Guan's house.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuchen new moon: the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 以河東節度使梁師成為太尉。

translations.literal: Liang Shicheng, military commissioner of Hedong, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong commissioner Liang Shicheng became Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 建德軍青溪妖賊方臘反，命譚稹討之。

translations.literal: At Qingxi in Jiande Army the demonic bandit Fang La rebelled; Tan Zhen was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Fang La, the Qingxi demon of Jiande Army, rose; Tan Zhen was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，余深罷，仍少傅，授鎮西軍節度使、知福州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: Yu Shen was dismissed but kept Junior Tutor; he was made military commissioner of Zhenxi Army and prefect of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai: Yu Shen left the council but kept Junior Tutor and took Zhenxi and Fu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以王黼為少保、太宰兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Wang Fu was made Junior Guardian, Grand Chancellor concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wang Fu became Junior Guardian and Grand Chancellor of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 己未，兩浙都監蔡遵、顏坦擊方臘，死之。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Zhejiang patrol commanders Cai Zun and Yan Tan attacked Fang La and were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhejiang commanders Cai Zun and Yan Tan struck Fang La and died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，改譚稹為兩浙制置使，以童貫為江、淮、荊、浙宣撫使，討方臘。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai: Tan Zhen was changed to Zhejiang pacification commissioner; Tong Guan was made pacification commissioner of Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe to campaign against Fang La.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dinghai: Tan Zhen became Zhejiang pacification commissioner and Tong Guan Jiang-Huai-Jing-Zhe pacifier to crush Fang La.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以少傅鄭居中權領樞密院。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Junior Tutor Zheng Juzhong was appointed to act as head of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Junior Tutor Zheng Juzhong was appointed acting head of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔訪兩浙民疾苦。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an edict ordered inquiry into the people’s hardships in the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict ordered inquiry into hardships in the two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 是月，方臘陷建德，又陷歙州，東南將郭師中戰死。

translations.literal: That month Fang La took Jiande, then She prefecture; southeast general Guo Shizhong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fang La took Jiande and She prefecture; southeast general Guo Shizhong fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 陷杭州，知州趙霆遁，廉訪使者趙約詬賊死。

translations.literal: He took Hangzhou; prefect Zhao Ting fled; surveillance commissioner Zhao Yue reviled the bandits and died.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou fell; prefect Zhao Ting fled; surveillance commissioner Zhao Yue cursed the rebels and was killed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，淮南旱。

translations.literal: That year Huainan suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year Huainan suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 夏國、真臘入貢。

translations.literal: Western Xia and Zhenla sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia and Zhenla sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬寅，鄧洵武卒。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, day renyin: Deng Xunwu died.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, spring, renyin: Deng Xunwu died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以安康郡王栩為太保，進封濟王；

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Prince of Ankang Xu was made Grand Guardian and advanced to Prince of Ji;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Prince of Ankang Xu became grand guardian and Prince of Ji;

sentences.zh: 鎮國公模為開府儀同三司，進封樂安郡王。

translations.literal: State Duke Mo was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies and advanced to Prince of Le’an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: State Duke Mo became Grand Master of the Palace and Prince of Le’an commandery.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔淮南、江東、福建各權添置武臣提刑一員。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict ordered Huainan, Jiangdong, and Fujian each to add provisionally one military circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Huainan, Jiangdong, and Fujian each gained a provisional military intendant.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷蘇、杭州造作局及御前綱運。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the manufacture offices and imperial transport fleets of Suzhou and Hangzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Suzhou and Hangzhou manufacture offices and imperial transport fleets were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷西北兵更戌。

translations.literal: Day yichou: rotation tours of northwest troops were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, northwest troop rotation tours were abolished.

sentences.zh: 罷木石彩色等場務。

translations.literal: The timber, stone, and pigment field offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Timber, stone, and pigment field offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 是月，方臘陷婺州，又陷衢州，守臣彭汝方死之。

translations.literal: That month Fang La took Wu prefecture, then Qu prefecture; defending official Peng Rufang died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fang La took Wu and Qu prefectures; defender Peng Rufang was killed.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，趙霆坐棄杭州，貶吉陽軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: Zhao Ting was demoted to Jiyang Army for abandoning Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengwu: Zhao Ting was banished to Jiyang Army for abandoning Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 罷方田。

translations.literal: Square-field [survey] was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The square-field land survey was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，降詔招撫方臘。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: an edict offered amnesty and pacification to Fang La.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict offered amnesty and pacification to Fang La.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷天下三舍及宗學、辟雍、諸路提舉學事官。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the empire’s three-college system and Directorate of Education, Directorate of the Sons of the State, and circuit education commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the three-college system, Directorate of Education, Imperial Academy, and circuit education posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 是月，方臘陷處州。

translations.literal: That month Fang La took Chu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fang La took Chu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淮南盜宋江等犯淮陽軍，遣將討捕，又犯京東、河北，入楚、海州界，命知州張叔夜招降之。

translations.literal: Huainan bandits Song Jiang and others attacked Huaiyang Army; troops were sent to pursue them; they also raided Jingdong and Hebei, entered Chu and Haizhou, and prefect Zhang Shuye was ordered to induce their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan bandits led by Song Jiang struck Huaiyang Army; pursuit failed as they raided Jingdong and Hebei and entered Chu and Haizhou; prefect Zhang Shuye was ordered to accept their surrender.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei: the emperor held the palace examination at the Hall of Assembled Elegance.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingwei: the palace examination was held at the Hall of Assembled Elegance.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身六百三十人。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: six hundred thirty Ministry of Rites examinees who had passed the name-list were granted jinshi rank and origin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, six hundred thirty named examinees received jinshi rank and origin.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，以鄭居中領樞密院。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: Zheng Juzhong took charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuxu: Zheng Juzhong took Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔杭、越、江寧守臣並帶安撫使。

translations.literal: Day jihai: an edict made Hang, Yue, and Jiangning prefects also serve as pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hang, Yue, and Jiangning prefects were also made pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追冊貴妃劉氏為皇后，諡曰明節。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Noble Consort Liu was posthumously enfeoffed as empress with posthumous title Mingjie.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Noble Consort Liu was posthumously made empress Mingjie.

sentences.zh: 改睦州、建德軍為嚴州、遂安軍，歙州為徽州。

translations.literal: Mu prefecture and Jiande Army were changed to Yan prefecture and Sui’an Army; She prefecture became Hui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mu became Yan prefecture, Jiande Sui’an Army, and She Hui prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金人再遣曷魯等來。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Jin envoys Helu and others came again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jin envoys led by Helu came again.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以興甯軍節度使劉宗元為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Xingning Army military commissioner Liu Zongyuan was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Liu Zongyuan of Xingning Army became Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔三省覺察台諫罔上背公者，取旨譴責。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Three Departments were ordered to detect censorial remonstrators who deceived the throne or were disloyal to the public good, and to seek imperial approval for censure and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Three Departments were told to expose remonstrators who deceived the throne or betrayed the public and seek orders for censure.

sentences.zh: 陳過庭、張汝霖以乞罷御前使喚及歲進花果，為王黼所劾，並竄貶。

translations.literal: Chen Guoting and Zhang Rulin, for begging abolition of imperial summons and annual fruit-and-flower tribute, were impeached by Wang Fu; both were exiled.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guoting and Zhang Rulin, for seeking an end to imperial summons and yearly fruit tribute, were impeached by Wang Fu and exiled.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙寅，減諸州曹掾官。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingyin: administrative assistants in the prefectures were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, bingyin: prefectural administrative assistants were cut.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立醫官額。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: medical officer quotas were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, medical officer quotas were set.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，復應奉司，命王黼及內侍梁師成領之。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Service-for-the-Throne Directorate was restored; Wang Fu and eunuch Liang Shicheng were put in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Service-for-the-Throne Directorate was restored under Wang Fu and the eunuch Liang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月，河決恩州清河埽。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the Yellow River broke through at Qinghe embankment in En prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: the Yellow River broke the Qinghe embankment in En prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，振溫、處等八州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingmao: Wen, Chu, and seven other prefectures were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingmao: Wen, Chu, and seven other prefectures were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，廢純、滋等十二州。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Chun, Zi, and eleven other prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Chun, Zi, and eleven other prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，童貫等俘方臘以獻。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Tong Guan and others presented the captive Fang La.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Tong Guan presented the captive Fang La.

sentences.zh: 是月，洛陽、京畿訛言有黑眚如人，或如犬，夜出掠小兒食之，二歲乃息。

translations.literal: That month in Luoyang and the capital region rumors told of a black pestilence like a man or like a dog that came out at night to seize and eat small children; it subsided after two years.
translations.idiomatic: That month Luoyang and the capital rumored a black pestilence, human or canine, that snatched children by night; the panic lasted two years.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，曲赦兩浙、江東、福建、淮南路。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiachen: partial amnesty in Liang-Zhe, Jiangdong, Fujian, and Huai-South circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiachen: partial amnesty in Liang-Zhe, Jiangdong, Fujian, and Huai-South.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以童貫為太師，譚稹加節度。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Tong Guan was made Grand Preceptor; Tan Zhen received a military commission.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Tong Guan became grand preceptor and Tan Zhen gained a military commission.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祔明節皇后神主于別廟。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Empress Mingjie’s spirit tablet was enshrined in a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Empress Mingjie’s tablet entered a separate temple.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，方臘伏誅。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Fang La was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Fang La was executed.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，以王黼為少傅，鄭居中為少師。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin: Wang Fu was made Junior Tutor; Zheng Juzhong Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingyin: Wang Fu became junior tutor and Zheng Juzhong junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚午，進執政官一等。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: chief councillors were advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, chief councillors were advanced one grade.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: grand sacrifice at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the grand Bright Hall sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，詔自今贓吏獄具，論決勿貨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: from now on when corrupt officials’ cases were complete and judgment given, redemption was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiayin: once corrupt officials’ cases were decided, redemption was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 童貫復領陝西、兩河宣撫。

translations.literal: Tong Guan again took command as pacification commissioner of Shaanxi and the two He regions.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan again took Shaanxi and the two He regions as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，馮熙載罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: Feng Xizai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingchou: Feng Xizai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以張邦昌為中書侍郎，王安中為尚書左丞，翰林學士承旨李邦彥為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Zhang Bangchang was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Wang Anzhong Vice Director of the Left; Hanlin Academy Academic Debater Li Bangyan Vice Director of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangchang became secretariat vice director; Wang Anzhong left vice director; Li Bangyan right vice director.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，封子桐為儀國公。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the son Tong was enfeoffed Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the son Tong was enfeoffed Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，張商英卒。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Zhang Shangying died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Shangying died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯朔，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao new moon: there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinmao new moon: a black spot appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬子，進封廣平郡王構為康王，樂安郡王模為祁王，並為太保。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Prince of Guangping commandery Gou was advanced to Prince Kang; Prince of Le’an Mo to Prince Qi; both were made Grand Guardians.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Prince of Guangping Gou became Prince Kang and Prince of Le’an Mo Prince Qi; both became grand guardians.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路蝗。

translations.literal: That year locusts [struck] the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts struck the circuits.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁卯，以蔡攸為少保，梁師成為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring, first month, day dingmao: Cai You was made Junior Guardian; Liang Shicheng Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4, spring, dingmao: Cai You became junior guardian and Liang Shicheng Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，金人破遼中京，遼主北走。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Jin forces took Liao Central Capital; the Liao ruler fled north.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Jin took Liao Central Capital and the Liao ruler fled north.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，以旱禱于廣聖宮，即日雨。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: because of drought, prayer was offered at Guangsheng Palace; rain fell that day.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingshen: drought prayers at Guangsheng Palace brought rain the same day.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day guimao: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以吳國公植為開府儀同三司，進封信都郡王。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Duke of Wu Zhi was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies and advanced to Prince of Xindu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Duke of Wu Zhi became Grand Master of the Palace and Prince of Xindu commandery.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，幸秘書省，遂幸太學，賜秘書少監翁彥深、王時雍、國子祭酒韋壽隆、司業權邦彥章服，館職、學官、諸生恩錫有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou: he visited the Directorate of Education, then the Imperial Academy; Secretariat Vice Directors Weng Yanshen and Wang Shiyong, Imperial Academy Chancellor Wei Shoulong, and Vice Chancellor Quan Bangyan were given official robes; academy posts, academy officials, and students received graded favors.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinyou: after the Directorate of Education and Imperial Academy, Weng Yanshen, Wang Shiyong, Wei Shoulong, and Quan Bangyan received robes and academy staff and students graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遼人立燕王淳為帝。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Liao people enthroned Prince of Yan Chun as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Liao enthroned Prince of Yan Chun.

sentences.zh: 金人來約夾攻，命童貫為河北、河東路宣撫使，屯兵于邊以應之，且招諭幽、燕。

translations.literal: Jin envoys came proposing a joint attack; Tong Guan was made pacification commissioner of Hebei and Hedong; troops were stationed on the frontier in response and were also to win over You and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Jin proposed a joint attack; Tong Guan became Hebei and Hedong pacification commissioner, massed border troops, and was to win over You and Yan.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，種師道退保雄州，遼人追擊至城下。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: Zhong Shidao withdrew to defend Xiong prefecture; Liao forces pursued to below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jichou: Zhong Shidao fell back to Xiong prefecture as Liao pursuers reached the walls.

sentences.zh: 帝聞兵敗，懼甚，遂詔班師。

translations.literal: The emperor heard the army had been defeated and was greatly afraid; he then ordered withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of defeat, the emperor was terrified and ordered withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以王黼為少師。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Wang Fu was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wang Fu became junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 是月，遼燕王淳死，蕭幹等立其妻蕭氏。

translations.literal: That month Prince of Yan Chun of Liao died; Xiao Gan and others enthroned his wife Lady Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liao’s Prince of Yan Chun died; Xiao Gan enthroned his wife Lady Xiao.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，廢貴妃崔氏為庶人。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiwei: Noble Consort Cui was demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiwei: Noble Consort Cui was demoted to commoner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，王黼以耶律淳死，復命童貫、蔡攸治兵，以河陽三城節度使劉延慶為都統制。

translations.literal: Day renwu: because Yelü Chun had died, Wang Fu again ordered Tong Guan and Cai You to mobilize troops; Heyang Three Cities military commissioner Liu Yanqing was made overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, after Yelü Chun’s death Wang Fu again ordered Tong Guan and Cai You to mobilize; Liu Yanqing of Heyang Three Cities became overall commander.

sentences.zh: 甲申，種師道責授右衛將軍致仕，和詵散官安置。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zhong Shidao was demoted to right guard general and retired; He Shou was given a sinecure placement.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhong Shidao retired as right guard general; He Shou received a sinecure placement.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，改燕京為燕山府，涿、易八州並賜名。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengyin: Yan capital was changed to Yanshan prefecture; Zhuo, Yi, and six other prefectures were all given new names.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengyin: Yan capital became Yanshan prefecture and Zhuo, Yi, and six others were renamed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，劉延慶與郭藥師等統兵出雄州。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Liu Yanqing with Guo Yaoshi and others led troops out of Xiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Liu Yanqing and Guo Yaoshi led troops out of Xiong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，曲赦所復州縣。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: partial amnesty for the restored prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, restored prefectures and counties received partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己亥，耶律淳妻蕭氏上表稱臣納款。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Yelü Chun’s wife Lady Xiao submitted a memorial declaring herself subject and offering surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Yelü Chun’s wife Lady Xiao submitted surrender as a subject.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，師次涿州。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the army reached Zhuo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the army reached Zhuo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，郭藥師與高世宣、楊可世等襲燕，蕭幹以兵入援，戰於城中，藥師等屢敗，皆棄馬縋城而出，死傷過半。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Guo Yaoshi with Gao Shixuan, Yang Keshi, and others raided Yan; Xiao Gan entered with relief troops; fighting in the city, Yaoshi and the rest were repeatedly defeated, all abandoned their horses and slid down ropes from the wall; casualties exceeded half.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Guo Yaoshi, Gao Shixuan, and Yang Keshi raided Yan; Xiao Gan relieved the city; after repeated defeats in street fighting they slid down ropes without their horses and lost more than half their men.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以蔡攸為少傅、判燕山府。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Cai You was made Junior Tutor and acting prefect of Yanshan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Cai You became junior tutor and acting prefect of Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，劉延慶自盧溝河燒營夜遁，眾軍遂潰，蕭幹追至涿水上乃還。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Liu Yanqing burned the camp and fled by night from the Lugou River; the host armies then collapsed; Xiao Gan pursued to the Zhuo River before turning back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liu Yanqing burned camp and fled by night from the Lugou River; the main force collapsed and Xiao Gan pursued to the Zhuo River.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔，行新璽。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen new moon: the new seal was used.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingchen new moon: the new seal was inaugurated.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the ancestral temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the ancestral temple was feasted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，祀昊天上帝於園丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the Lord on High was sacrificed at the Round Mound; the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Lord on High was sacrificed at the Round Mound and the realm pardoned.

sentences.zh: 東南官吏昨緣寇盜貶責者，並次第移放，上書邪上等人特與磨勘。

translations.literal: Southeastern officials previously demoted and censured on account of banditry were all to be transferred and released in order; those who had memorialized with malicious accusations received special merit review.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastern officials demoted for the banditry were gradually restored; those who had filed malicious memorials received special merit review.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金人遣李靖等來許山前六州。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Jin envoys Li Jing and others came promising the six prefectures south of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Jin envoys led by Li Jing promised the six prefectures south of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 以彰德軍節度使鄭詳為太尉。

translations.literal: Zhangde Army military commissioner Zheng Xiang was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xiang of Zhangde Army became grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，郭藥師敗蕭幹於永清縣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai: Guo Yaoshi defeated Xiao Gan at Yongqing county.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dinghai: Guo Yaoshi defeated Xiao Gan at Yongqing county.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣趙良嗣報聘于金國。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zhao Liangsi was sent on a return mission to the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhao Liangsi was sent on a return mission to Jin.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以郭藥師為武泰軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Guo Yaoshi was made military commissioner of Wutai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Guo Yaoshi became military commissioner of Wutai Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，金人入燕，蕭氏出奔。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Jin forces entered Yan; Lady Xiao fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jin entered Yan and Lady Xiao fled.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，使來獻捷。

translations.literal: Day renchen: envoys came presenting a victory report.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, envoys came with a victory report.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔監司未經陛對，毋得之任。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered that supervisory officials who had not yet faced the throne might not take up their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, circuit supervisors who had not yet had a throne audience could not take office.

sentences.zh: 丙申，貶劉延慶為率府率、安置筠州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Liu Yanqing was demoted to heir apparent guard commander and placed at Jun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liu Yanqing was demoted to heir-apparent guard commander and placed at Jun prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，進封植為莘王。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zhi was advanced to Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhi was advanced to Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月戊午，金人遣李靖來議所許六州代租錢。

translations.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, day wuwu: Jin envoys Li Jing came to negotiate the substitute-rent money for the six promised prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5, spring, wuwu: Li Jing of Jin came to negotiate substitute rent for the six promised prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣趙良嗣報聘，求西京等州。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Zhao Liangsi was sent on a return mission seeking Western Capital and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhao Liangsi was sent back to Jin seeking Western Capital and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以王安中為慶遠軍節度使、河北河東燕山府路宣撫使、知燕山府。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wang Anzhong was made military commissioner of Qingyuan Army, pacification commissioner of Hebei, Hedong, and Yanshan prefecture circuit, and prefect of Yanshan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wang Anzhong became Qingyuan military commissioner, Hebei-Hedong-Yanshan pacification commissioner, and Yanshan prefect.

sentences.zh: 甲申，錄富弼後。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: descendants of Fu Bi were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, descendants of Fu Bi were registered for favor.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉朔，以李邦彥為尚書左丞，翰林學士趙野為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou new moon: Li Bangyan was made Vice Director of the Left; Hanlin Academician Zhao Ye Vice Director of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiyou new moon: Li Bangyan became left vice director and Zhao Ye right vice director.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，金人以議未合，斷橋樑，焚次舍。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: because negotiations were not settled, Jin men cut the bridges and burned the lodging sheds.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, talks unresolved, Jin troops cut bridges and burned lodging sheds.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，進封雍國公朴為華原郡王，徐國公棣為高平郡王，並為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Duke of Yong State Pu was advanced to Prince of Huayuan commandery and Duke of Xu State Di to Prince of Gaoping commandery; both were made opening-establishment equal in rank to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Pu of Yong State became Prince of Huayuan and Di of Xu State Prince of Gaoping; both received opening-establishment rank equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，金人再遣寧術割等來。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: Jin again sent Ning Shuge and others.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yimao: the Jin again sent Ning Shuge and others.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣盧益報聘，皆如其約。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Lu Yi was dispatched on a return embassy; all followed the agreement.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Lu Yi was sent on a return embassy, and all terms were kept.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，金人遣楊璞以誓書及燕京、涿、易、檀、順、景、薊州來歸。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guisi: Jin sent Yang Pu with the oath text and the return of Yanjing and Zhuo, Yi, Tan, Shun, Jing, and Ji prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guisi: Jin sent Yang Pu with the oath and the return of Yanjing and Zhuo, Yi, Tan, Shun, Jing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 庚子，童貫、蔡攸入燕，時燕之職官、富民、金帛、子女先為金人盡掠而去。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Tong Guan and Cai You entered Yan; by then Yan’s officials, wealthy households, gold, silk, and women had already been wholly plundered by the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Tong Guan and Cai You entered Yan, but officials, the rich, gold, silk, and women had already been stripped by the Jin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，童貫表奏撫定燕城。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Tong Guan memorialized that Yan city had been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Tong Guan reported Yan city pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，曲赦河北、河東、燕雲路。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: a partial amnesty was granted in Hebei, Hedong, and the Yan-Yun circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Hebei, Hedong, and Yan-Yun received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是日班師。

translations.literal: That day the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That day the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，以收復燕、雲，賜王黼玉帶。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei: for recovering Yan and Yun, Wang Fu was given a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiwei: recovering Yan and Yun brought Wang Fu a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以王黼為太傅，鄭居中為太保，進宰執官二等。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Wang Fu was made Grand Preceptor and Zheng Juzhong Grand Guardian; chief ministers were advanced two grades.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Fu became Grand Preceptor and Zheng Juzhong Grand Guardian; chief ministers rose two grades.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王黼總治三省事。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wang Fu took overall charge of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wang Fu took overall charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，童貫落節鉞，進封徐、豫國公。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Tong Guan was stripped of command seals and advanced to Duke of Xu and Yu states.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Tong Guan lost his command seals and was advanced to Duke of Xu and Yu.

sentences.zh: 蔡攸為少師。

translations.literal: Cai You was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You became Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔正位三公立本班，帶節鉞若領他職者仍舊班，著為令。

translations.literal: Day chou: an edict fixed the three chief ministers in the main court rank; those with command seals who held other posts kept their former rank—made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On chou, the three chief ministers were fixed in the main court rank; those with command seals in other posts kept their old rank, as a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，祭地于方澤。

translations.literal: Day you: the earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On you, the earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人許朔、武、蔚三州。

translations.literal: That month the Jin granted Shuo, Wu, and Yu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin granted Shuo, Wu, and Yu.

sentences.zh: 金主阿骨打殂，弟吳乞買立。

translations.literal: Jin ruler Aguda died; his younger brother Wuqimai succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Jin ruler Aguda died; his younger brother Wuqimai succeeded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，以梁師成為少保。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu: Liang Shicheng was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuwu: Liang Shicheng became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 己未，童貫致仕。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Tong Guan retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Tong Guan retired.

sentences.zh: 起復譚稹為河北、河東、燕山府路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Tan Zan was recalled from mourning to be pacification commissioner of Hebei, Hedong, and the Yan Mountains prefecture circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zan was recalled from mourning as pacification commissioner of Hebei, Hedong, and the Yan Mountains circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太傅、楚國公王黼等上尊號曰繼天興道敷文成武睿明皇帝，不允。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Grand Preceptor and Duke of Chu Wang Fu and others offered the honorific Continuing Heaven, Raising the Way, Spreading Culture, Martial Sagacity, and Illuminated Emperor; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Grand Preceptor Wang Fu of Chu and others offered the honorific Continuing Heaven, Raising the Way, Spreading Culture, Martial Sagacity, and Illuminated Emperor; it was refused.

sentences.zh: 禁元祐學術。

translations.literal: Yuanyou learning was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou learning was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳朔，日當食不見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi new moon: an eclipse was due but did not appear.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinsi new moon: an eclipse was due but did not show.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命王安中作《復燕雲碑》。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Wang Anzhong was ordered to compose the Stele on Recovering Yan and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Wang Anzhong was ordered to compose the Stele on Recovering Yan and Yun.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Venus showed by day.

sentences.zh: 是月，蕭幹破景州、薊州，寇掠燕山，郭藥師敗之。

translations.literal: That month Xiao Gan took Jing and Ji prefectures and raided the Yan Mountains; Guo Yaoshi defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Gan took Jing and Ji and raided the Yan Mountains; Guo Yaoshi defeated him.

sentences.zh: 幹尋為其下所殺，傳首京師。

translations.literal: Soon Gan was killed by his subordinates; his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Gan was killed by his men; his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: a grand sacrifice was held at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinyou: the Bright Hall saw a grand sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiyou: trees bore ice rain.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiyou: trees bore ice rain.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，罷諸路提舉常平之不職者。

translations.literal: Day renyin: superintendents of the Ever-Normal Granaries who were derelict were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, derelict Ever-Normal Granary superintendents were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月乙卯，為金主輟朝。

translations.literal: Year 6, spring, first month, day yimao: court was suspended for the Jin ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6, spring, yimao: court was suspended for the Jin ruler.

sentences.zh: 戊午，置書藝所。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: a Calligraphy Institute was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, a Calligraphy Institute was established.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，藏蕭幹首於太社。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Xiao Gan’s head was stored at the Grand Altar of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Xiao Gan’s head was stored at the Grand Altar of Earth.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣連南夫弔祭金國。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Lian Nanfu was sent to mourn at the Jin court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Lian Nanfu was sent to mourn at the Jin court.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，以冀國公㮙為開府儀同三司，進封河間郡王；

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Duke of Ji State Kai was made opening-establishment equal in rank to the Three Excellencies and advanced to Prince of Hejian commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: Duke of Ji Kai received opening-establishment rank equal to the Three Excellencies and became Prince of Hejian;

sentences.zh: 韶州防禦使令蕩為婺州觀察使，封安定郡王。

translations.literal: Shaozhou defense commissioner Lingdang was made Wuzhou observation commissioner and enfeoffed Prince of Anding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou defense commissioner Lingdang became Wuzhou observation commissioner and Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 己亥，躬耕藉田。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the emperor personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔自今非曆台閣、寺監、監司、郡守、開封府曹官者，不得為郎官、卿、監，著為令。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: an edict—from now on, unless one had served in the Astronomical Bureau, directorates, supervisorates, circuit office, prefectural or county magistracy, or Kaifeng sub-office, one could not become a court gentleman or directorate official; made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, only those who had served in the Astronomical Bureau, directorates, supervisorates, circuits, prefectures, counties, or Kaifeng sub-offices might become court gentlemen or directorate officials—a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 李邦彥以父憂去位。

translations.literal: Li Bangyan left office on his father’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bangyan left office to mourn his father.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉朔，以錢景臻為少師。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou new moon: Qian Jingzhen was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiyou new moon: Qian Jingzhen became Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 金人來匄糧，不與。

translations.literal: Jin came begging grain; it was not given.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin begged grain; none was given.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，皇后親蠶。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinsi: the empress personally raised silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, xinsi: the empress raised silkworms.

sentences.zh: 庚子，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: at the Hall of Assembled Elegance the emperor examined jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, jinshi were examined at the Hall of Assembled Elegance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身八百五人。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guichou: eight hundred five graduates and qualifiers of the Ministry of Rites list were granted ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guichou: eight hundred five Ministry of Rites graduates received rank.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，李邦彥起復。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Li Bangyan was recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Li Bangyan was recalled from mourning.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renyin: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金人遣使來告嗣位。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Jin sent envoys announcing the new succession.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Jin envoys announced the new succession.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，詔以收復燕、雲以來，京東、兩河之民困于調度，令京西、淮、浙、江、湖、四川、閩、廣並納免夫錢，期以兩月納足，違者從軍法。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: an edict—since recovering Yan and Yun, the people of Jingdong and the two He circuits had been worn down by levies; Jingxi, Huai, Zhe, Jiang, Hu, Sichuan, Min, and Guang were all to pay corvée-exemption money, to be delivered within two months on pain of military law.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renzi: since Yan and Yun were recovered, Jingdong and the two He circuits had been crushed by levies; Jingxi, Huai, Zhe, Jiang, Hu, Sichuan, Min, and Guang were ordered to pay corvée-exemption money within two months or face military law.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，遣許亢宗賀金國嗣位。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuzi: Xu Kangzong was sent to congratulate the Jin succession.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuzi: Xu Kangzong was sent to congratulate the Jin succession.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔：應系御筆斷罪，不許詣尚書省陳訴改正。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict—cases judged by imperial brush were not to be appealed for revision at the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, cases judged by imperial brush could not be appealed for revision at the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔宗室、後妃戚裏、宰執之家概敷免夫錢。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict—imperial clansmen, consorts, affinal kin, and chief ministers’ households were all to pay corvée-exemption money without exception.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, imperial clansmen, consorts, affinal kin, and chief ministers’ households were all ordered to pay corvée-exemption money without exception.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置璣衡所。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: an Armillary Sphere Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, an Armillary Sphere Office was established.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，譚稹落太尉、罷宣撫使，童貫落致仕，領樞密院代之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao: Tan Zan was stripped of Grand Marshal and dismissed as pacification commissioner; Tong Guan left retirement and took the Bureau of Military Affairs in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yimao: Tan Zan lost Grand Marshal and his pacification post; Tong Guan left retirement to head Military Affairs in his place.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以溢機堡為安羌城。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Yiji Fort was renamed Anqiang City.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yiji Fort was renamed Anqiang City.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以復燕、雲，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day renxu: for recovering Yan and Yun, the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, recovering Yan and Yun brought an empire-wide amnesty.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，以白時中為特進、太宰兼門下侍郎，李邦彥為少宰兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yihai: Bai Shizhong was made extraordinary advance and Grand Preceptor with concurrent vice director of the Chancellery; Li Bangyan was made Junior Preceptor with concurrent vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yihai: Bai Shizhong became extraordinary advance, Grand Preceptor, and Chancellery vice director; Li Bangyan became Junior Preceptor and Secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 蔡攸落節鉞。

translations.literal: Cai You was stripped of command seals.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You was stripped of command seals.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: a grand sacrifice was held at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Bright Hall saw a grand sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以趙野為尚書左丞，翰林學士承旨宇文粹中為尚書右丞，開封尹蔡懋同知樞密院。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Zhao Ye was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Hanlin Academician and Chief Drafter Yuwen Cuizhong was made right vice director; Kaifeng intendant Cai Mao was made associate director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zhao Ye became left state-affairs vice director; Yuwen Cuizhong became right vice director; Cai Mao became associate director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以金芝產于艮岳萬壽峰，改名壽嶽。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: because golden fungus grew on Wanshou Peak at Genyue, it was renamed Mount Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, golden fungus on Genyue’s Wanshou Peak led to renaming it Mount Longevity.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金人遣富謨弼等以遺留物來獻。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Jin sent Fu Mobi and others with leftover goods as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Jin sent Fu Mobi and others with leftover goods as tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，詔有收藏慣用蘇、黃之文者，並令焚毀，犯者以大不恭論。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengwu: an edict—whoever habitually kept writings of Su and Huang was to burn them; offenders were charged with great irreverence.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengwu: habitual keepers of Su and Huang’s writings were ordered to burn them; offenders faced a charge of great irreverence.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔內外官並以三年為任，治績著聞者再任，永為式。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict—all inner and outer officials were to serve three-year terms; those with outstanding records might serve again—made permanent practice.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, inner and outer officials were given three-year terms; the outstanding might serve again—a permanent rule.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，王黼致仕。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: Wang Fu retired.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingzi: Wang Fu retired.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus showed by day.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷應奉司。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Service-to-the-Throne Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Service-to-the-Throne Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，令尚書省置講議局。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Ministry of Justice was ordered to establish a Deliberation Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to establish a Deliberation Bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔監司擇縣令有治績者保奏，召赴都堂審察錄用，毋過三人。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict—circuit supervisors were to recommend magistrates with good records, summon them to the chief council hall for review and appointment, not exceeding three men.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, circuit supervisors were to recommend able magistrates, summon no more than three to the chief council for review, and appoint them.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰朔，蔡京領講議司。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen new moon: Cai Jing headed the Deliberation Office.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon: Cai Jing headed the Deliberation Office.

sentences.zh: 詔百官遵行元豐法制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the hundred officials to follow Yuanfeng statutes.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials were ordered to follow Yuanfeng statutes.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔內外侍從以上各舉所知二人。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict—inner and outer attendants of fifth rank and above were each to recommend two men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, inner and outer attendants of fifth rank and above were each to recommend two men they knew.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，蔡京落致仕，領三省事。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Cai Jing left retirement and took charge of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Cai Jing left retirement and took the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河北、山東盜起，命內侍梁方平討之。

translations.literal: That year bandits rose in Hebei and Shandong; the inner attendant Liang Fangping was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: That year bandits rose in Hebei and Shandong; inner attendant Liang Fangping was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 京師、河東、陝西地大震，兩河、京東西、浙西水，環慶、邠甯、涇原流徙，令所在振恤。

translations.literal: The capital, Hedong, and Shaanxi were shaken by great earthquakes; the two He circuits, Jingdong west, and western Zhe suffered floods; Huanqing, Binning, and Jingyuan saw displacement—the locales were ordered to relieve and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: The capital, Hedong, and Shaanxi were shaken by great earthquakes; the two He, western Jingdong, and western Zhe flooded; Huanqing, Binning, and Jingyuan saw displacement—and localities were ordered to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 夏國、高麗、于闐、羅殿入貢。

translations.literal: Western Xia, Goryeo, Khotan, and Luodian sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia, Goryeo, Khotan, and Luodian presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸酉朔，詔赦兩河、京西流民為盜者，仍給復一年。

translations.literal: Year 7, spring, first month, day guiyou new moon: an edict amnestied displaced people of the two He and Jingxi who had turned bandit, and granted them tax relief for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Year 7, spring, guiyou new moon: displaced bandits of the two He and Jingxi were amnestied and given one year’s tax relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔罷諸路提舉常平官屬，有罪當黜者以名聞，仍令三省修已廢之法。

translations.literal: Day guisi: an edict abolished the staff of circuit Ever-Normal Granary superintendents; those who should be dismissed were to be reported by name, and the Three Departments were to restore abolished laws.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, circuit Ever-Normal Granary staffs were abolished; dismissals were to be reported by name, and the Three Departments were to restore abolished laws.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，復置鑄錢監。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: coin-casting directorates were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiachen: coin-casting directorates were restored.

sentences.zh: 詔御史察贓吏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered censors to investigate corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: Censors were ordered to investigate corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: trees bore ice rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, trees bore ice rain.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔京師運米五十萬斛至燕山，令工部侍郎孟揆親往措置。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict ordered five hundred thousand hu of grain transported from the capital to the Yan Mountains; Works Vice Minister Meng Kui was sent in person to arrange it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, five hundred thousand hu of grain were ordered from the capital to the Yan Mountains; Works Vice Minister Meng Kui went in person to arrange it.

sentences.zh: 己巳，進封廣國公栻為南康郡王、福國公榛為平陽郡王，並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Duke of Guang State Shi was advanced to Prince of Nankang commandery and Duke of Fu State Zhen to Prince of Pingyang commandery; both were made opening-establishment equal in rank to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Shi of Guang State became Prince of Nankang and Zhen of Fu State Prince of Pingyang; both received opening-establishment rank equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京東轉運副使李孝昌言招安群盜張萬仙等五萬餘人，詔補官犒賜有差。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Jingdong transport deputy Li Xiaochang reported pacifying the bandit Zhang Wanxian and more than fifty thousand men; an edict granted offices and rewards in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Jingdong deputy Li Xiaochang reported pacifying Zhang Wanxian and more than fifty thousand bandits; graded offices and rewards were granted.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔，雨雹。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiyou new moon: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guiyou new moon: hail fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申，知海州錢伯言奏招降山東寇賈進等十萬人，詔補官有差。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Haizhou prefect Qian Boyan memorialized pacifying the Shandong raider Jia Jin and one hundred thousand men; an edict granted offices in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Haizhou prefect Qian Boyan reported pacifying Shandong raider Jia Jin and one hundred thousand men; graded offices were granted.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以惠國公楧為開府儀同三司，進封建安郡王。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Duke of Hui State Yuan was made opening-establishment equal in rank to the Three Excellencies and advanced to Prince of Jian’an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yuan of Hui State received opening-establishment rank equal to the Three Excellencies and became Prince of Jian’an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，降德音於京東、河北路。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingchen: a gracious pronouncement was issued in Jingdong and Hebei circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingchen: Jingdong and Hebei received a gracious pronouncement.

sentences.zh: 庚申，蔡京復致仕。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Cai Jing retired again.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cai Jing retired again.

sentences.zh: 復州縣免行錢。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were restored to exemption from transit fees.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were restored to exemption from transit fees.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔行元豐官制。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict put Yuanfeng office regulations into effect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yuanfeng office regulations took effect.

sentences.zh: 復尚書令之名，虛而勿授；

translations.literal: The name Director of the Masters of Writing was restored, left vacant and not conferred;
translations.idiomatic: The title Director of the Masters of Writing was restored but left vacant and unbestowed;

sentences.zh: 三公但為階官，毋領三省事。

translations.literal: the Three Dukes were only rank posts and no longer headed the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: the Three Dukes were rank posts only and no longer headed the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，封子樅為潤國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renwu: the son Cong was enfeoffed Duke of Run State.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renwu: the son Cong was enfeoffed Duke of Run.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔諸路帥臣舉將校有才略者、監司舉守令有政績者歲各三人。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict—circuit commanders were each year to recommend three officers of talent and circuit supervisors three magistrates with political achievement.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, circuit commanders were to recommend three able officers yearly and circuit supervisors three magistrates with achievement.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑朔，詔宗室復著姓。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinchou new moon: an edict restored the imperial clan surname.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinchou new moon: the imperial clan surname was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙午，封童貫為廣陽郡王。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Tong Guan was enfeoffed Prince of Guangyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Tong Guan was enfeoffed Prince of Guangyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔臣僚輒與內侍來往者論罪。

translations.literal: Day wushen: an edict—officials who dealt with inner attendants were to be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, officials who dealt with inner attendants were to be punished.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 己未，以蔡攸為太保。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Cai You was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Cai You became Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔吏職雜流出身人，毋得陳請改換。

translations.literal: Day guihai: an edict—men of clerical and miscellaneous origins were not to petition for change of status.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, men of clerical and miscellaneous origins could not petition to change status.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷減六尚歲貢物。

translations.literal: Day chou: the six inner treasuries’ annual tribute goods were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On chou, the six inner treasuries’ annual tribute was reduced.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午朔，詔士庶毋以「天」、「王」、「君」、「聖」為名字，及以壬戌日輔臣焚香。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu new moon: an edict—for commoners, “Heaven,” “King,” “Lord,” and “Sage” were not to be used as personal names; on renxu days chief ministers were to burn incense.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengwu new moon: commoners were forbidden personal names using Heaven, King, Lord, or Sage; on renxu days chief ministers burned incense.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以河間郡王㮙為太保，進封沂王。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Prince of Hejian Kai was made Grand Guardian and advanced to Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Prince of Hejian Kai became Grand Guardian and Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 是月，河東義勝軍叛。

translations.literal: That month the Yisheng Army of Hedong rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yisheng Army of Hedong rebelled.

sentences.zh: 熙河、河東路地震。

translations.literal: Xihe and Hedong circuits were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xihe and Hedong were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，大饗明堂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: a grand sacrifice was held at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinsi: the Bright Hall saw a grand sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，金人以擒遼主，遣李孝和等來告慶。

translations.literal: Day renchen: because they had captured the Liao ruler, Jin sent Li Xiaohe and others to announce the victory.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, having captured the Liao ruler, Jin sent Li Xiaohe and others to announce victory.

sentences.zh: 是月，河東言粘罕至雲中，詔童貫復宣撫。

translations.literal: That month Hedong reported Nianhan had reached Yunzhong; an edict restored Tong Guan as pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hedong reported Nianhan at Yunzhong; Tong Guan was restored as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 有狐升禦榻而坐。

translations.literal: A fox climbed onto the imperial couch and sat.
translations.idiomatic: A fox climbed onto the imperial couch and sat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，賜曾布諡曰文肅。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinhai: Zeng Bu was given the posthumous title Cultured and Stern.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinhai: Zeng Bu received the posthumous title Cultured and Stern.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷京畿和糴。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: capital-region grain purchase was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, capital-region grain purchase was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，詔：無出身待制以上、年及三十通歷任滿十歲，乃許任子。
